# Will your retreat make money, and how many guests do you need?

> Free calculator for retreat, workshop and group-trip organizers: break-even guests, profit by turnout, the cost of a venue guaranteed minimum and of early-bird seats, and the price that hits your profit target. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
